sourceRules.movingDotMaskException: DOCreateAll clears selected properties on mask miss but retains movement and reads the inline Pascal program. Level 58 has 36 moving dots, not 20.
sourceRules.newControls: No new key binding established; sliding changes the context of existing G/B/reverse actions and permits a human grab to a connector. Physical controller behavior remains unqualified.

HY.record: Grid position, pair/channel word, 32-bit mask for version >9; older default mask 15. Mask filtering precedes allocation.
HY.pairing: Find by dot first; otherwise allocate. Find another matching pair/channel excluding self. Linked records hold partner dot; an unmatched record returns its own dot from HYGetPartner, missing record returns -1. Duplicate/more-than-two construction is order-dependent and not generator-qualified.
HY.animation: Group 2000, layer 7 mapped to physical 4; pair p uses bounds 2*p+1..2*p+2, paired ends start complementary. Shared MT timer requested period 500; no wall-time conversion asserted.
HY.teleport: DOGrabbed handles ordinary source hooks, then HYGetPartner and WATeleport, followed by DP hook at destination. WATeleport requires ordinary WAInfo flag +0x28 (excludes rotating spikes/type 5), starts fader, changes pivot and sprite position, leaves angular state, and checks wall collision at current frame; collision invokes death reason 36. No recursive destination DOGrabbed and no destination DOCanGrab call in this path.
HY.reset: HYReset repositions each sprite using its current dot anchor; it does not rebuild pairs or explicitly reset frame/clock. Moving-dot rider update also repositions HY sprites.

EX.source: CODE6:55ec-60a2; WA c3a2-c5bc, c65e-c79c, d200-d54e, d898-d98a
EX.record: Grid position plus orientation byte and another byte. No difficulty mask. Orientation 1 extends one grid row; other values extend one column. All batch records use 0/1 and second byte 0; nonzero byte semantics remain unqualified.
EX.appearance: Group 3100; appearance inherits first endpoint look/color, with bonus set when either endpoint has a bonus. Source removes runtime bonus bit before this recomputation. Original background/shadow and exact anchors need native qualification.
EX.routes: EXGetDirs sets right/down/left/up route bits 1/2/4/8. DOWillSlide positive angular quarters use bits 2/4/8/1; negative use 8/1/2/4. Start only at cardinal and not already sliding.
EX.motion: Progress 0..16; fixed three-pixel step in route direction per actor class inner step; angle retained. Stop at 16 releases old endpoint, assigns adjacent endpoint, calls DOGrabbed and snaps; it does not apply ordinary transfer +32. Reverse negates angular step, progress step and velocity; returning to <=0 clears sliding.
EX.humanConnectorGrab: DOCanGrab fallback 44d6-44f8 occurs only when no dot found, human argument true and moving-origin argument true. EXFindGrabbable selects first connector whose endpoint rectangle intersects target +/-3 pixel box; result is marked connector (not real dot). WAGrab computes along-connector progress by coordinate difference /3. While already sliding, WAAction passes moving-origin false, so this connector fallback is disabled.
EX.ordering: Human one-frame collision -> stop slide -> direct input -> start slide -> death/win freeze -> animate. Enemy one-frame animate -> collision -> stop slide -> program -> start slide. Preserve per-class inner-step loops.
EX.qualification: Midpoint pickup, exact boundaries, connector bonus lifecycle, wall/death and dynamic endpoint combinations need native scenarios; static transfer helper explicitly rejects EX.

movingDots.instruction: Initialize elapsed 0, duration 16, plan first instruction; each DOOneFrame increments elapsed and, if moving, translates main/shadow and positions riders. At elapsed >=16, clear elapsed, set duration16, plan next instruction. p therefore waits sixteen callbacks.
movingDots.clock: Uses WA class 1 timer. DOFrameProc invokes DOOneFrame once, then exactly once more when shared class delta >1, not an unrestricted delta loop. For moving mode it records the intermediate position and flag before second call. DOCanGrab first tests current position, then the saved intermediate position after failure.
movingDots.riders: DOPositionAllRiders calls WA, HY, DO rider handling, DP, LI and BO hooks. Actor pivot identity remains the source dot slot while its current position moves. Source callback order must be retained.
movingDots.reset: DOInitMoveInfo resets instruction counter, progress and source initial positions, plans first command, snapshots current timer, and repositions riders; shared timer itself is not restarted.
movingDots.mask: Movement is not cleared at 3aee-3b06 on property-mask miss; level58 requires36 active moving dots.
movingDots.programCapacity: Observed max length60. Source local/DOInfo storage uses a 128-byte Pascal area; do not emit arbitrary long strings. A conservative generator gate <=127 plus nonempty/legal-opcode and closed/in-bounds trajectory validation is required before generation, not a claim the source safely rejects oversized inputs.
movingDots.programSemantics: Raw bit 0x80. Independent Pascal program with PC initially 1; fetch then increment/wrap to 1. n/s/w/e set Point velocity up/down/left/right by 3; p and unrecognized bytes produce stationary instruction. The observed opcode alphabet is e/n/p/s/w.

raw0x2000.look: Raw property becomes runtime look bit8; selected appearance uses group300/shadow4100 frame108+colorOffset where not overridden by higher-priority dot types. Distinct from raw0x40 protection.
raw0x2000.predicate: DODeathBecomesMe(oldDot,grabSpec) is true iff grabSpec denotes real dot and both old and target look contain bit8. Connector targets return false.
raw0x2000.effect: Only human WAGrab calls predicate; true clears sprite angular step and invokes RODied reason37. Function continues old-dot release, assignment, angle+32 and subsequent grab handling. Do not early-return before these mutations.
raw0x2000.noncases: Single marked endpoint, bounce without transfer, enemy transfer and mere occupied/contact state do not invoke this human-transfer death branch. Sliding endpoint completion and HY teleport do not call WAGrab in the traced paths.

generationRequirements: Preserve 8x11 serialized indexing separately from display dimensions; mode masks, presence, colors and every independent property must retain source order.
Filter WA/SP/PU/GO/WY/EL/HY by actual record mask before allocation. BO/EX/WL/DR/DS have no equivalent mask. Moving dot programs survive dot-property mask misses.

Keep canonical angle, direction, initial Pascal PC, clock multiplier/divisor/slowdown, program references, human action flags, slide progress/vector, dynamic anchor and previous-position state. Continuous SVG interpolation must not drive game decisions.
Preserve source physical callback order, especially moving dots before ordinary enemies/human; source multi-delta behavior differs between dots and actors.
Validate paired HY endpoints after mode filtering, using exactly two endpoints per generated channel and valid source frame ranges; qualify duplicate/unmatched cases separately.
Validate EX capacities, endpoint orientation, source lookup order and connector collision/pickup geometry; ordinary static transfer support is insufficient.
Validate moving programs as nonempty Pascal strings, known opcodes and bounded trajectories; retain global identity as dots move and permit source overlaps only after lookup-order tests.
Validate HY22, EX61, EL12, misc43, BO60, LI starter5, spark17, explosion6 and DP lifetime-allocation32 source limits; level45 already reaches EX61.
Keep raw0x2000 separate from protection and ordinary hazard collisions; test the old-and-new endpoint predicate and mutation order on death.

No new RNG call was found in traced HY/EX/moving-dot/transfer-death paths. Existing death, goodies, oil/pursuit and bomb effects still require their own source RNG consumption order and replay seed; this survey is not an exhaustive RNG audit.
Generated levels need semantic validation, inventory/asset checks, solvability and sequential native/runtime acceptance; no generation or acceptance is supplied here.

visualInventory.outlineQualification: No new collider or SVG produced. Original descriptor/outline data and native anchor validation are required before integration. Existing private PNG file counts are not assertions of descriptor counts.

validation.checks: Source inventory assertions, SHA256 and focused private disassembly review only.

uncertainties: No catalog41-60 level is accepted, rendered, played or activated by this survey.
New HY and EX art/collider anchors, fader timing and physical control behavior have no native evidence here.
EX second byte is zero throughout this batch; nonzero semantics are not qualified.
Simultaneous moving/up-down/ring/checkpoint, explosion, oil and teleport interactions need dedicated source/native integration checks.
Moving-dot multi-delta intermediate-position fallback is source-established; arbitrary large-delta scheduling and exact native input windows are not measured.
HY request period500 is a source timer value, not asserted seconds; generic timer conversion must be retained.
Source storage limits and generation validation do not imply the original gracefully handles malformed records.
